title: Decky Legacy Profile (ABI v1)
description: Exact schema for the legacy Decky plugin profile ABI at the generated root profiles/<id>.json. This shape is frozen — it must never change without a new ABI version — because the existing Decky plugin reads it directly. It is always generated from library/canonical/profiles/<id>.json, never authored by hand and never the source of truth.

version.description: Frozen ABI version marker. Any breaking change to this shape requires version 2 and a migration, never an in-place edit of v1.

id.description: Must equal the filename stem, i.e. profiles/<id>.json.

description.description: Optional. Absent entirely when there is no description (not null).

artwork.description: Profile-level artwork override. A string identifies the generated legacy artwork path/token; null explicitly means "no art change" (leave whatever is currently applied). This field is never omitted — omission is not a valid substitute for null.

mods.description: Per-game mod selections. At most one entry per distinct "game" value in this array (unique per game) — enforced by validation tooling in addition to this schema, since plain JSON Schema cannot express uniqueness keyed on a single object property. Each entry is a complete set: applying it fully replaces any prior mod selection for that game, there is no partial/merge semantics.

$comment: Reserved ids: "deck-default" and "steam-default" are always retained and never pruned by garbage collection. "steam-default" is retained specifically as an empty marker: mods == [] and artwork == null, representing deliberate absence of overrides rather than an unmigrated/missing profile.
